action_not_found: The remote action is no longer known. It may have expired; start it again.
action_not_supported: The device software does not support this yet. Bring the device to the server version first.
actions_busy: Too many remote actions are still waiting for this device. Wait until they have finished.
alert_not_active: The device no longer has this problem.
already_aligned: The screen already runs the server version.
asset_in_use: Some files are still used as product images and cannot be deleted: {names}. Choose another product image first.
bad_range: The upload data did not arrive completely. Try again – the upload continues where it stopped.
bundle_invalid: The file is not a valid OpenSignage release bundle: {detail}
category_in_use: The category is still used by product lists in these presentations (archived ones included): {presentations}. Remove it there first.
category_not_empty: The category still contains products ({products}, archived ones included) or subcategories ({subcategories}). Move or delete them first.
certificate_invalid: Certificate and key do not match or cannot be read.
chunk_too_large: An upload part is larger than {max}.
conflict: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload and try again.
content_create_denied: You may not create presentations or playlists.
content_read_only: This content also runs in zones without edit access. Copy it for your zone instead.
copy_global_rule: This content runs in every zone through a global rule; only an administrator can change that.
copy_not_in_zone: This content does not run in this zone.
copy_not_shared: This content runs only in this zone and can be edited directly.
csrf: The page is outdated. Reload it and try again.
default_exists: This zone already has a default rule (“{rule}”). Edit that rule instead.
device_not_found: The screen was not found. It may have been deleted.
device_platform_unknown: The platform of this screen is unknown. It is reported when the screen is paired again.
disk_full: Not enough free disk space: {needed} needed, {free} free. Delete unused media or empty the trash.
download_interrupted: The download was interrupted by a restart. Start it again; it continues where it stopped.
field.currency_mismatch: {field}: the price must be in the currency of the product ({currency}).
field.duration_xor_repeat: Choose either a duration or a number of repetitions, not both.
field.has_subcategories: A category with subcategories cannot become a subcategory.
field.invalid_color: {field} must be a colour such as #ff8a00.
field.invalid_parent: A subcategory cannot contain further subcategories.
field.media_only: {field} is only allowed for media files.
field.mixed_categories: Only products of the same category can be sorted together.
field.mixed_levels: Only categories of the same level can be sorted together.
field.needs_image: “Image instead of name” needs an image.
field.no_access: No access to the selected content.
field.no_zone: A device without zone cannot be in a display group.
field.password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
field.playlist_prices_or_ticker_required: A rule needs a playlist, a price or a ticker.
field.presentation_not_published: The presentation is not published yet.
field.single_track_only: Whole presentations are only possible in playlists for one screen.
field.slide_not_published: The slide is not part of the published presentation.
field.tracks_require_duration: In playlists for several screens every step has a fixed duration.
field.unknown_action: This remote action is not known.
field.unknown_asset: The chosen media file does not exist anymore.
field.unknown_font: {field}: this font is not available on the server.
field.unknown_group: The display group does not exist (any more) in this zone.
field.unknown_playlist: The playlist does not exist or is archived.
field.unknown_reference: {field} refers to something that does not exist anymore.
field.unknown_ticker_template: The ticker template does not exist (anymore).
field.wrong_asset_kind: {field}: this kind of media file is not allowed here.
file_missing: The stored file is missing on the server. Upload it again with “Replace file”.
folder_cycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its subfolders.
font_exists: This font family with this style and weight has already been uploaded.
font_family_reserved: “{family}” is the name of an included font. Choose another family name.
font_in_use: The font “{family}” is still used by presentations or ticker templates ({usage}). Change the font there first.
forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
github_rate_limited: GitHub limits the number of requests. Try again after {until}.
github_repo_not_found: The update repository {repo} was not found.
github_unreachable: The update source cannot be reached ({detail}). Check the internet connection.
group_in_use: Schedule rules set a playlist for this group: {rules}. Remove it there first.
group_name_taken: The zone already has a display group with this name.
in_trash: This is in the trash. Restore it first.
insufficient_disk: Not enough free disk space: {neededMb} MB needed, {freeMb} MB free.
internal: Internal server error. The problem was logged.
invalid_font: This is not a valid TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 font file.
job_active: The file is already being processed.
key_invalid: This is not a valid release key (expected osk1:…).
kind_mismatch: The new file must be of the same kind as the old one ({expected}).
last_admin: At least one active administrator must remain.
login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
media_forbidden: You may not do this with media.
media_not_own: Only your own uploads and folders can be changed.
name_taken: A folder with this name already exists here.
network: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection.
never_published: There is no published version to go back to.
no_client_packages: The packages of version {version} for the screens are missing. Download that release or upload its file.
no_package: The server has no package of version {version} for this screen ({platform}).
no_rollout: No update of the screens is running.
no_screenshot: There is no screenshot of this device yet. Use the “Screenshot” remote action first.
no_server_package: The release has no package for this server ({platform}).
not_found: Not found. It may have been deleted.
not_in_trash: This is not in the trash (anymore).
nothing_to_update: All screens already run the server version.
package_checksum_mismatch: A downloaded file is damaged (checksum mismatch). Download it again.
pairing_not_found: No device is waiting to be taken over with this PIN. Check the PIN shown on the screen; it is only valid for a limited time.
playlist_archived: The playlist is archived. Restore it first.
playlist_in_use: The playlist is still used by Time Schedules or zones. Remove it there first.
presentation_archived: The presentation is archived. Restore it first.
presentation_in_use: The presentation is still used by these playlists: {playlists}.
product_archived: The product is archived. Restore it first.
product_in_use: The product is still used by Time Schedules or presentations. Remove it there first.
product_not_archived: Only archived products can be deleted. Archive the product first.
release_in_use: Version {version} is being installed or distributed right now.
release_invalid: The release is incomplete or invalid: {detail}
release_not_found: This release is not known. Check for updates first.
release_not_ready: Version {version} has not been downloaded and verified yet.
release_signature_invalid: The release signature does not match any trusted key. The release was rejected.
release_version_mismatch: The release files belong to another version ({version}).
restart_unavailable: A restart is not available in this mode.
restore_busy: Another backup is being uploaded for a restore. Wait until it has finished.
restore_invalid: The file is not a valid OpenSignage backup.
restore_newer: The backup is from a newer version. Update the server first.
restore_references_missing: This cannot be restored because it uses content that no longer exists, is archived or in the trash: {references}. Restore that content first.
rollout_cancelled: Not started because the update of the screens stopped after a failure.
rollout_failed: The update of the screens stopped: {device} failed.
rollout_running: An update of the screens is already running.
server_not_installed: This server was not installed with the installer, so it cannot update itself. ({detail})
server_update_rolled_back: The new version failed and was rolled back: {detail}
setup_done: Setup has already been completed. Please log in.
slide_in_use: Published playlists still play these slides: {slideNames} (playlists: {playlists}). Keep the slides or remove them from the playlists first.
status_admin_only: Only administrators decide whether a product is carried (“Not available”). Switch between available and sold out instead.
svg_unsafe: The SVG file contains scripts, event handlers or external references and was rejected.
ticker_template_in_use: The ticker template is still used by: {used}.
timeout: The server took too long to answer.
too_many_groups: The zone already has the maximum number of display groups.
too_many_named_versions: At most {max} named versions per presentation. Remove the name of another version first.
too_many_uploads: Too many unfinished uploads (maximum {max}). Wait until running uploads have finished.
unsupported_type: This file type is not supported ({detected}). Allowed are images, videos and audio files.
update_busy: Another update operation is running. Wait until it has finished.
update_failed: The screen could not install the update.
update_in_progress: A server update to {version} is in progress.
update_interrupted: The update was interrupted before the restart.
update_not_supported: The player software on this screen cannot update itself yet.
update_rolled_back: The screen returned to its previous version.
update_timeout: The screen did not come back with the new version in time.
upgrade_from_too_old: Version {current} is too old for this update. Install version {min} first.
upload_offset: The upload was out of step with the server (received: {received}). Try again – it continues where it stopped.
variant_not_found: This version of the file does not exist (yet).
version_not_newer: Version {version} is not newer than the running version {current}.
window_overlap: The time window overlaps with “{rule}”, which changes the same thing. Rules may only overlap when they change different things.
zone_forbidden: You may not change this zone.
